description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Abduction triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Iridescent Drake trigger, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
